Monetaria Villas

Villa in Rawai
HomeSaleMonetaria Villas

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Monetaria Villas is a development of 35 single-storey private pool villas near Rawai Beach on Phuket's southern tip, off Soi Werachod. Two layouts are offered: a 3-bedroom Type A of about 274 sqm and a 4-bedroom Type B of about 375 sqm, on plots of roughly 320 to 520 sqm. The project includes a clubhouse, fitness center, coworking space and cafe.

Monetaria Villas: key facts

  • Monetaria Villas is a pool villa in Rawai, Phuket.
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 274.1–374.9 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Apr 2025.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿18,900,000.
  • Nearest beach: Nai Harn and Ya Nui beaches (within 5 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Lighthouse Phuket school (0.9 km); BCIS Phuket International School (7.3 km); Dibuk Hospital (10.9 km); Bangkok Hospital Phuket (15 km).
